skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to pronounce English sounds accurately, recognize and correct their own pronunciation errors, and apply appropriate stress and intonation in various sentence types.
Students will improve their ability to understand spoken English, including recognizing different accents and dialects.
Students will enhance their communication skills by practicing pronunciation in various contexts and improving their fluency.
Students will develop the ability to independently practice and improve their pronunciation outside of class.
Students will work effectively in pairs and groups to practice pronunciation and receive feedback.
